callbackUrls.intro: The addresses PayNow sends payment notifications to and returns customers to. The plugin sets them in PayNow itself after the configuration is saved with API keys — for production and sandbox. They are built from a sales channel domain, including its path (e.g. /en).
callbackUrls.notificationHelp: Webhook PayNow sends payment statuses to — without it orders never change to paid. Any shop domain works (including a /pl or /de prefix); the production and the sandbox panel use the same one.
callbackUrls.returnHelp: Fallback only — with every payment the plugin sends its own return address on the domain the customer ordered from.
callbackUrls.copyError: Copy failed — please copy the address manually
callbackUrls.domainLoadError: The addresses could not be computed. Enter your shop domain including its path in the PayNow panel (e.g. https://your-shop.com/en/payment/notification) or reload the page.
callbackUrls.noDomain: This sales channel has no storefront domain, so no addresses can be built. Add a domain in the sales channel settings.
callbackUrls.configureHelp: Sends the addresses above to PayNow with the keys in the form (unsaved ones too). Do it after a domain change or when order statuses do not update. If it fails, copy the addresses into the PayNow panel (Settings → Shops and payment points).
callbackUrls.configureFailed: The addresses could not be set in PayNow for at least one environment — details below.
callbackUrls.configureNoKeys: No API keys — enter production or sandbox keys.
callbackUrls.configureError: Could not reach the shop server.
